question: En mieloma múltiple, ¿cuántos fármacos distintos se están probando o se probaron en ensayos?

attempts.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT td.parent_chembl_id)
FROM linking.trial_drug td
JOIN linking.trial_condition tc ON tc.nct_id = td.nct_id
JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id
WHERE md.label = 'Multiple Myeloma'
